q: What are the fixed trip dates?
why: The brief's own process requires fixed dates first (step 1). No dates were provided, so the site covers the full verified window Nov 17 – Dec 23, 2026 with a date filter.
how_to_resolve: Decide arrival/departure dates (or a window). Everything else on the schedule page then collapses to those days.

q: What is the nightly budget and minimum quality floor for the hotel?
why: The brief says cost and quality outrank distance but gives no dollar ceiling or quality bar. Verified reference points: Venetian poker rate from $119+$55 fee+tax = $197.28/night all-in (conditional on 6h cash play or $300+ tournament buy-in per night); sampled public Venetian rate Nov 27–30 = $767.30/night all-in average.
how_to_resolve: State a max true cost/night (rate + resort fee + 13.38% tax) and a quality floor (e.g., 4-star+ Strip center).

q: Are re-entry, re-buy and add-on rules written anywhere for the Venetian DSE IV events?
why: All 37 official structure sheets were read line by line on 2026-11-17. Only sheet 8 (Events #18/#58) contains entry-count language ('All subsequent buy in's…'). No sheet states single-entry, freezeout, re-entry limits or add-on terms for the other events.
how_to_resolve: Call the Venetian poker room (702.414.7657) or email lv_cas_poker@venetianlasvegas.com and ask for written maximum-entry / no-rebuy / no-add-on rules per event; attach the reply to each row and re-run the single-entry toggle.

q: Which hotel will be the stay base (for walking-route verification)?
why: Walking minutes can only be verified per hotel–venue pair. No property publishes official walking times; only the Venetian/Palazzo pair is verified (room is inside the building).
how_to_resolve: Pick the hotel, then verify the walking route once via the Google/Apple Maps link on the hotel row and record the minutes; the ≤30-min filter turns on for that row.

q: How many players and what occupancy (single/double)?
a: 2 adults assumed in the captured Venetian quote.
why: Venetian quotes start at double occupancy; extra guests add $50/night (official terms). Poker suite rates are single/double too.
how_to_resolve: Confirm traveler count; if >2 per suite, add the official per-guest charge to the trip calculator.

q: Is the goal volume (as many tournaments as possible) or value (best guarantee ÷ fee)?
why: The brief says both ('enter as many live tournaments' and 'best based on cost and prize pool'). These conflict: the highest-ratio events (multi-flight, long Day 2s) block whole days.
how_to_resolve: Choose a primary objective. The schedule page currently builds for volume with value noted per row.

q: Are bounty and satellite formats acceptable, or strictly freezeout-style NLH?
why: Venetian guarantees for bounty events include bounty money (not comparable to pure prize pools), and satellites pay seats, not cash. Both are labeled separately per the brief.
how_to_resolve: Say whether bounty events count toward the daily quota and whether satellite seats (e.g., $260 → $2,200 seat) are in scope.

q: What is the policy for events whose single-entry status is unverified?
why: Zero events are confirmed single-entry. Strictly applying 'single-entry only' leaves an empty schedule; the site currently shows candidates with no contrary evidence in the main list and all multi-entry-evidence events in the separate section.
how_to_resolve: Decide: (a) accept unverified candidates as provisional, (b) phone-verify before each entry, or (c) play only confirmed-rule events (currently: none).

q: Cancellation tolerance: must all bookings be refundable?
why: Venetian prepaid offers are non-refundable (deposit forfeited); Wynn offer terms capture full deposit non-cancellable; Caesars direct bookings advertise free 48-hour cancellation (asterisked).
how_to_resolve: Set a rule (e.g., refundable-only until 48h before each night) and the trip calculator will filter rate options accordingly.

q: Which rooms beyond Venetian/Wynn/Bellagio/Caesars/ARIA must be covered?
why: Sahara, Resorts World, The STRAT, Park MGM, Mandalay Bay, Cosmopolitan and Planet Hollywood were not checked in this pass (flag F12).
how_to_resolve: Confirm the must-cover list; the morning re-check job already loops every room with an official URL in scripts/scrape_daily.py.
